{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column to confirm it's string with commas
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
print("\nAny revenue values contain commas?", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Check for the internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nNumber of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
